user-centric.definition: A structural architecture where data is centralized around the individual (the central node) rather than platform-centered models.

data-sovereignty.definition: The foundational concept of decentralizing control away from central organizations, empowering individuals with absolute functional ownership to dictate exactly who uses their data.

re-decentralization.definition: An architectural effort aimed at reversing the trend of centralized platforms, returning the web to its intended decentralized state.

pod.definition: Personal Online Datastore; the technical mechanism where users store information to retain complete control and ownership over their personal datasets.
